conflicts.resolution: Online payments will not be included in the first version.

dimensions.justification: Goals are to increase visibility and attract customers. Success is measured by website visitors, WhatsApp enquiries, and conversions (bookings/orders) reviewed after one month.
Target audience is tourists. Mobile-first approach specified for 4G connections. Language is English only for launch.
Needs for homestay (rooms/contact), restaurant (menu/timings/directions), and boat tours (tours/safety) are clearly attributed to Lakshmi, Ravi, and Meena.
Single-page website with three distinct sections for the businesses is clearly defined.
Features include WhatsApp buttons with pre-filled messages, map integration for directions, and content sections for each business.
Acceptance criteria provided for all three business sections using clear conditions for completion.
Owners provide their own content/photos. Lakshmi coordinates collection. Developer to optimize photos.
Calm natural coastal theme specified with defined color palette (ocean blue, sandy beige, white, warm sunset).
Mobile-first, 3-second load time on 4G, and image optimization are specified.
Budget ($400), deadline (5 days), and maintenance plan (Lakshmi coordinates) are clearly stated. Online payments are explicitly out of scope.
